test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 20 Jun, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: An electric pump can fill a tank in 6 hours. Due to a leakage in the tank, it takes 7(1/3) hours to fill the tank. How much time will this leak take to empty the full tank if water does not get in or out of the tank through any other point during this period?"
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Net time with **leakage** = 7(1/3) = 22/3 hours.

Emptying time = (Product of times) ÷ (Difference of times)

Emptying time = (6 × 22/3) ÷ (22/3 − 6)

Emptying time = 44 ÷ (4/3) = 44 × 3/4 = 33 hours.

**∴ The correct answer is 33 hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Filling time (A) = 6 hours, Filling time with leak (A+L) = 22/3 hours.

**Formula Used:** Total Work = LCM of time; Efficiency = Total Work ÷ Time.

 
 **Pipe/Leak** **Time (hr)** **Total Work (L)** **Efficiency (L/hr)** 
 **Pump (A)** 6 66 11 
 **Pump + Leak (A+L)** 22/3 9 

⇒ Efficiency of **Pump** (A) = 11 units/hr

⇒ Efficiency of **Pump + Leak** (A+L) = 9 units/hr

⇒ Efficiency of **Leak** (L) = 9 − 11 = −2 units/hr (Negative sign indicates emptying)

⇒ Time taken by **Leak** to empty = Total Work ÷ Efficiency of Leak

⇒ Time = 66 ÷ 2 = 33 hours.

**∴ The correct answer is 33 hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Pipes and Cisterns Basics

Inlet pipes have positive efficiency, while **leakage** or outlet pipes have negative efficiency.

Total Work Calculation

When handling fractions like 22/3 and 6, take the **LCM of the numerators** (LCM of 22 and 6 is 66) to find the total capacity.

Time, Work, and Efficiency

Efficiency is inversely proportional to **Time** when the total capacity of the tank remains constant.</p
